name: a2z-power-solution
description: A2Z Power Solution: public website + Service Desk webapp (webapp/) and API server (server/).

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,webapp -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w webapp"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w webapp
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w webapp
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run format:check && npm run build
